data.name: Heading
data.comment: The Music section's heading in the inspector, also its tab in a narrow window. One short word.

data.name: EmptyHint
data.value: A song under the video, cut and faded to fit its length. MP4 only.
data.comment: The line under the heading while the project has no music: what the section does. The song is cut where the video ends and faded in and out; only MP4 videos carry sound (a GIF has none).

data.name: AddButton
data.comment: The button that opens the file dialog to choose a song (an audio file) for the video. The ellipsis says a dialog opens.

data.name: AddName
data.comment: The Add button's screen reader name.

data.name: ReplaceButton
data.comment: The button beside the chosen song that opens the file dialog to choose another song in its place.

data.name: ReplaceName
data.comment: The Replace button's screen reader name.

data.name: RemoveButton
data.comment: The button that takes the song out of the project. It never deletes the file from the disk: use the word for "remove", not "delete".

data.name: RemoveName
data.value: Remove the music from the project
data.comment: The Remove button's screen reader name: the music leaves the project, the file stays on the disk.

data.name: SongName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the chosen song: {0} is the file's name (Sunrise.mp3), {1} its length, already formatted (3 min 42 s).

data.name: StartLabel
data.comment: The label above the slider that picks where in the song the video starts (to skip a slow intro).

data.name: StartName
data.value: Where the video starts in the song
data.comment: The start slider's screen reader name.

data.name: FadeInLabel
data.comment: The label above the slider for how long the music takes to rise from silence at the start of the video.

data.name: FadeOutLabel
data.comment: The label above the slider for how long the music takes to fall to silence where it ends.

data.name: FadeInName
data.comment: The fade in slider's screen reader name.

data.name: FadeOutName
data.comment: The fade out slider's screen reader name.

data.name: FitsVideo
data.value: The song plays under the whole video and fades out as it ends.
data.comment: Under the sliders when the song is longer than the video: it is cut where the video ends, with the fade out just before.

data.name: EndsEarly
data.value: The song ends {0} before the video does; the rest is silent.
data.comment: Under the sliders when the song ends before the video: {0} is how much earlier, already formatted (6.2 s, 1 min 12 s). The music is never repeated.

data.name: StartsAfterEnd
data.value: The video starts after the song ends, so it has no music. Move the start back.
data.comment: Under the sliders when the start point is at or past the end of the song: the video has no music until the start is moved back.

data.name: GifSilent
data.value: A GIF has no sound. Export an MP4 to keep the music.
data.comment: Under the controls while the output format is GIF: an animated GIF has no sound, so the music only goes into MP4 videos.

data.name: Missing
data.value: {0} can't be found. Replace it, or remove the music.
data.comment: In place of the controls when the song's file is not where the project says (moved, renamed, a drive not connected): {0} is the file's name.

data.name: Unreadable
data.value: {0} can't be played. Choose an MP3, M4A, WAV, WMA or FLAC file.
data.comment: An InfoBar after choosing a file that does not play: {0} is the file's name. The formats are file types: keep MP3, M4A, WAV, WMA and FLAC as they are.

data.name: ExportFailed
data.value: The music file can't be read. Replace or remove it in the Music section, then export again.
data.comment: An InfoBar when an export stopped because the music file could not be read (gone, damaged). "Music section" names the section of the inspector (the Heading above).
